FINDINGS TO FIX (line numbers from the review, approximate):
1. HIGH :647 PACKET INJECTION — raw draft text is copied into Linear card bodies/comments unescaped; a draft containing the literal marker line 'OPEN_ENGINE_GATE_PACKET' would supersede the legitimate packet (the parser takes the NEWEST packet across description+comments). Fix: sanitize EVERY piece of draft-derived text (subject, body excerpts, QA reasons quoting the draft) before it enters any card body or comment — replace the marker substring with a visibly-defanged form (e.g. 'OPEN_ENGINE_GATE_PACKET[defanged-draft-content]') and also defang any 'action_class:'/'auto_approved_class:'/'gmail_draft_id:' key-value lines inside quoted draft text. Add a test that a malicious draft body containing a full fake packet cannot alter the parsed packet of the resulting card (use the real parser from scripts/open_engine_gate_enforcement.py path-imported read-only, or replicate its newest-wins parse in the test).
2. HIGH :135 HOLDS FAIL-OPEN — a missing/corrupt SEND-HOLDS.json (or hold-source read error) currently yields an empty hold set and the suppression check PASSES. Fix: read/parse failure = suppression check result 'unavailable' = chain FAIL (no marker), reason visible on the card.
3. HIGH :928 STALE-BODY QA — a failed post-rewrite Gmail refresh is swallowed and QA tags the stale body. Fix: refresh failure = chain FAIL (no marker) with reason 'draft refresh failed — QA not run on final body'.
4. HIGH :235 LINK-GATE BYPASS — only visible http(s) text is scanned. Fix: also extract URLs from HTML href/src attributes and markdown links; treat scheme-relative (//x.y) and bare-domain tokens (www.x.y, x.y/path for known TLD-looking tokens) as link candidates; any candidate not an EXACT-host match (casefolded, no subdomain wildcards beyond an explicit allowlist entry) = FAIL. Document (comment) that network redirect resolution is out of scope by design — the allowlist is exact-host + path-prefix.
5. HIGH :574 RECEIPT NOT BOUND TO PAYLOAD — a draft edited after QA keeps its stale marker. Fix: qa_receipt gains 'payload_sha256' computed with the SAME canonicalization as the executor's exact_send_payload_sha256() (read that function and mirror it precisely; cite its file:line in a comment). The receipt binds the marker to the exact bytes QA saw.
6. HIGH :173 UTC HOLD EXPIRY — hold expiration compares the UTC date, releasing ET holds at 8pm local. Fix: hold date comparisons use the pipeline's America/New_York business date (zoneinfo).
7. MED :241 REFERRER BINDING — referral drafts accept ANY allowlisted episode URL as the referrer link. Fix: when the draft is a referral/nominee intro, the episode URL must be verifiably bound to the NAMED referrer (derive the expected URL/slug from the referrer identity via the same source outreach.py uses; mismatch or underivable = FAIL).
8. MED :578 + :790 OPERATOR HONESTY — when the marker IS present the card must say plainly that it will AUTOSEND on the next executor run unless a human replies SKIP (never 'nothing sends until Ankit replies'); when blocked, keep the waiting wording. The newest review comment must include the full QA-chain results, not only voice QA, so a human APPROVE decision sees every failed check.
9. MED test honesty — the all-pass test currently stubs the style gate unconditionally and uses a four-URL fixture that the real one-CTA rule would reject. Fix: the all-pass test must run the REAL style gate (scripts/style_gate is present in this tree) against a genuinely compliant single-CTA draft; keep separate stubbed tests only for gate-absent fail-closed behavior.

Also extend tests: holds-corrupt → no marker; refresh-failure → no marker; href/bare-domain bypass attempts → no marker; payload_sha256 present and changes when body changes; ET-vs-UTC hold boundary case; referrer mismatch → no marker; marker-present card contains the autosend warning text. ALL existing tests must pass (update those asserting old wording, list them in fix-summary).

(Other gate files are not yours — note in fix-summary if they need the same treatment as follow-up.)

MED ensure_referral_touch_tracker.py ~:83 — the exists-check and the atomic replace are not synchronized: a good tracker written concurrently between check and replace gets clobbered by the ensured empty report. Fix: create-if-missing must use exclusive creation (os.open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, or equivalent link-based atomic claim) so a concurrent writer's file is NEVER overwritten; the corrupt-quarantine path must take an flock on a sibling .lock file and re-verify corruption inside the lock before moving anything.

HIGH server/pipeline/referral_touch_automation.py ~:122 — the action gate trusts any complete-looking tracker without validating schema, generation time, or freshness, so a stale or fabricated tracker can authorize outreach. Follow the module's existing error/reporting conventions — read the module fully first; this is a LIVE pipeline file, change the minimum necessary.
